title: Anderson .Paak and Cordae reunite for feel-good new single 'A Good Day'

blocks.text: GRAMMY-Award winning artist Anderson .Paak and GRAMMY-nominated, multi-platinum rapper Cordae today share “A Good Day”, the first single off their recently announced forthcoming collaborative album, ‘Heavy Is the Crown’, arriving October 23rd via APESHIT + EMPIRE / Hi Level + Mass Appeal. An uplifting, soul-drenched anthem, “A Good Day” finds .Paak tapping back into his charismatic rap roots alongside Cordae’s effortless flow, as the two trade witty bars over live drum grooves and infectious production. Fans can stream the new album HERE and watch the video HERE.
